headline: Energy & Gold Miners lead on Hormuz oil shock; Utilities & REITs crushed by 4.94% 10-yr yield; August CPI & Sept 15-16 FOMC are the week's make-or-break pivots.
Brent above $100 on Iran war escalation lifts Energy (+82) and Defense (+75) while rising 10-yr yield at 4.84% crushes Real Estate (−62); PPI today, CPI Friday, FOMC next week.

Energy & Defense lead on Iran-war oil shock (+43% YTD XLE); Consumer Discretionary and Homebuilders are the clearest shorts; CPI (Sep 11) and FOMC hike decision (Sep 16) are the week's make-or-break catalysts.

Energy (XLE +43% YTD) dominates as Iran/Hormuz disruption keeps WTI near $92; Consumer Discretionary is the only red sector — NKE at 12-yr lows; FOMC rate decision Sep 16 is the week's biggest risk for all sectors.
Energy (+86) and AI/Semis (+56) lead; Homebuilders (-52) and Staples (-40) lag — NFP print at 8:30 AM is the session's binary event, with Sep 16 FOMC hike odds near 50-66%.
